doc_name: 船舶工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 稳定造船订单，保持生产增长
quote_en: Stabilise shipbuilding orders and keep output growing.
notes: Headline of a dedicated plan; target 2011 output 50 Mt and 35%+ of world completions. Restriction side: 严格控制新增产能 (no new dock/slipway applications; expansions of existing yards suspended for three years) - judged subordinate to the stabilise-and-grow thrust. Also 积极发展远洋渔船、特种船、工程船、工作船等专用船舶.

doc_name: 船舶工业调整和振兴规划
notes: Dedicated task (三); target 10% world market share by 2011; VAT rebate for rigs sold to domestic offshore oil firms.

doc_name: 船舶工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 加快新型船用柴油机及其关键零部件、甲板机械、舱室设备、通信导航自动化设备的自主研发
quote_en: Speed up in-house R&D of new marine diesel engines and key parts, deck machinery, cabin equipment and navigation/communication automation.
notes: Quantitative targets: 65% on-board share of locally made equipment, 80% domestic satisfaction for low/medium-speed diesel engines.

doc_name: 船舶工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 大型液化天然气船、大型液化石油气船、大型汽车运输船、科学考察船等高技术高附加值船舶
quote_en: High-tech, high-value ships such as large LNG, LPG and car carriers and research vessels.
notes: Sentence: 提高…设计开发能力. Target: 20% world market share by 2011.

doc_name: 船舶工业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 鼓励造船企业利用现有造船设施开展修船业务
quote_en: Encourage shipbuilders to use existing facilities for ship repair.
notes: Dedicated item (七) 积极发展修船业务.

doc_name: 船舶工业调整和振兴规划
quote_en: Develop ship breaking in a regulated way.
notes: Designated-site dismantling (实行定点拆解). No SW industry fits.

doc_name: 船舶工业调整和振兴规划
concept_zh: 老旧船舶与单壳油轮淘汰
concept_en: scrapping of old ships and single-hull tankers
quote_zh: 抓紧出台单壳（包括单壳双底和双壳单底）油轮强制淘汰政策，严禁超龄船舶改造、运营
quote_en: Hurry out a mandatory phase-out policy for single-hull tankers and strictly ban conversion or operation of over-age ships.
notes: Restriction falls on fleet owners/shipping but the stated aim is to create new-build demand; also 研究鼓励老旧船舶报废更新政策 and 鼓励骨干航运企业购买…弃船. Mapping to 航运港口 is a judgement.
